change: AI-assisted close wording clarification with explicit confirmation
behavior: Clear misspellings are instructed to proceed without needless clarification.
Clear false, strange or nonsensical source claims remain the original claim to check; unrelated requests keep their existing scope boundary.
AI can supply a standalone question in the detected input language only as a close wording repair; missing quotes/facts are never supplied by the suggestion.
A deterministic edit-distance guard limits the Yes shortcut, not retrieval or verification admission.
Yes submits the exact visible proposal and its language through the unchanged verification endpoint; No focuses and preserves the original composer text.
Editing the composer clears stale clarification; missing or legacy proposals expose Edit my question only.
Clarification shows a compact card instead of an empty evidence report.

checks.production_build: passed after final mobile focus adjustment
checks.test_api_proxy: All /api routes intercepted locally, no provider requests forwarded

limitations: New model prompt behavior has not been live-tested; offline fixtures check contracts and UI, not actual model decisions.
Edit distance restricts rewrite size but cannot prove semantic equivalence; the user explicitly confirms the full proposed question.
Open-ended model clarification text retains existing English/Arabic summaries; interface controls cover all nine languages.
Previous 30-question score is for its frozen earlier candidate; no claim that this change improves that live score.
